opportunities.title: [FEAT-0247] Interactive chart positions and draggable TP/SL lines
opportunities.summary: > **Depends on:** FEAT-0017, FEAT-0070 # FEAT-0247 — Interactive chart positions and draggable TP/SL lines ## Problem Traders monitoring charts in Cachy currently have to switch between the candlestick view and the trade/positions panel or TP/SL modal to see their open positions, entry prices, liquidation thresholds, and resting take-profit/stop-loss levels. Modifying a stop-loss or take-profit requires opening an edit modal and typing numerical values by hand. TradingView and modern exchange terminals allow traders to see their active positions and resting TP/SL orders directly on the price chart as horizontal price lines, and to drag those lines to adjust TP/SL orders interactively. ## Proposal Leverage Lightweight Charts v5 APIs (`createPriceLine`, `priceToCoordinate`, `coordinateToPrice`) in `CandleChartView.svelte` to: 1. Render live price lines for the active symbol's open position (Entry, Liquidation) and pending TP/SL orders. 2. Display distance (% and USDT PnL) directly on the line labels. 3. opportunities.title: OI 卡 v2：完整标题与报价 + CoinGlass 清算水平 shadow
opportunities.summary: ## Problem Two related reader-market-context gaps share the same delivery/working-set seam. 1. OI telemetry already parses and persists all four numbers, but the Feishu header only shows `{symbol} 持仓异动 {pct}`; the remaining OI value, Whale/OI ratio, whale-long profit, and 4h rank live only in `why_zh`, so notification previews hide the complete signal. 2. A deterministic OI verdict carries one primary perp asset, but Gate grounding is deliberately empty. `card_assets()` therefore removes that asset and Deliverer never requests the existing Quote Snapshot. Quote planning also reads only `news_event_assets`, so a new OI-only symbol is not guaranteed to be warmed. 3. We need a bounded shadow of `AnalyThothAI/coinglass-cli liquidation-levels` to measure coverage, payload change, staleness, errors, and clustering feasibility before any liquidation data reaches a reader card. Live read-only reproduction on 2026-08-22 confirmed a DOGE Event with OI +8.64%, OI value $73.01M, Whale/OI 210.97%, whale-long profit 80.60%, rank 1, decision push, delivery sent. The delivered header was short while the complete metrics were in the first body line. DOGE Quote Snapshot existed; `grounded_assets=[]`

opportunities.title: [Bounty $1500] ttnn.erfinv: no accurate fp32 path at all, ~0.2% peak relative error near the domain edges
opportunities.summary: ## Summary `ttnn.erfinv` computes the inverse error function using only the Winitzki (2008) closed-form approximation (`a = 0.147`) — a deliberately cheap, low-accuracy analytical formula, not a minimax fit. Unlike every other SFPU kernel checked in this codebase (`sigmoid`, `tanh`, `gelu`, `softplus` — all have a real `APPROXIMATION_MODE`-gated fast-vs-accurate split), `calculate_erfinv`'s `APPROXIMATION_MODE` template parameter is never actually used: there is exactly one code path, hardcoded, regardless of precision mode.
